scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text:
Why don't you come back after becoming stronger?
Maybe, level 130.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: A long time ago, this castle did not look like this.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Ah, I'm sorry. I'm muttering in front of a stranger.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: My name is Hugin. I'm studying the dimensional gap between time and space.
There's something like that here?

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Have you ever wondered about the history of Glast Heim?

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: There was a King named Shumiche who was known as a tyrant in the history of the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Time will reveal the true answers if we look in the right places.
I don't care about history
That is interesting. Did you find anything?

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Really? Hmm, please come back later when you are interested then.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Actually, dimensional time travel is possible but I'm too afraid to go there.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: It might be possible for you!

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Do you want to time travel?
No, thanks.
Yes, of course I do!

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Really? But, jumping gigawatts, this is such a great opportunity.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: I knew that you would understand what I said. Well, please tell me what you want to do.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Umm? Did you see me at another place? I don't think so. What about this time?

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Why don't you make a party with more than 1 person and talk to me again?

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Have we met before? No way. It's my first time seeing you. What do you want?

scripts.speaker: Hugin
Hugin

[Hugin]
Oh, my...

Enter Old Glast Heim

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text:
Oh, my...
You still have after-effects of time travel. You can't travel again with this condition.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Staying healthy is important, so please take a break and come back again later.
^0000ffAll traces of access to Old Glast Heim have been removed. Now you can talk with Hugin again.^000000

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: Where's your leader? I need his help.
You have a previous clear record. You can skip the scenario and proceed accordingly.
Omit moderately.
Appreciate everything.

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text:
I've seen you, {0}.
I'm sure I can trust you. Let's leave right away.

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: Are you the one ^0000ffHerico^000000 sent to help me?
Oh. Well I...
Ah yes, I am. Herico told me to meet you.

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: We don't have much time. We must report to Sir Heinrich about Himelmez's invasion.
Himelmez...
Who is Himelmez?

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: Herico didn't tell you?

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: She is the Ruler of Death, Dead man's Valkyrie. Himelmez is looking to take the heart of Ymir from us.

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: She might even destroy this whole castle if she wanted to.

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: Hurry! Report to Sir. Heinrich about Himelmez. I must check the defense barrier here!

scripts.speaker: Khalitzburg Knightage
scripts.text: My work shift will be over soon, but the next crew is not coming.

scripts.speaker: Khalitzburg Knightage
scripts.text: Something you want to tell me?

scripts.speaker: White Knight
scripts.text: Are you with Varmundt? Commander is waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Khalitzburg Knightage
scripts.text: I had a weird dream last night. My mom was in it... Wonder if she is ok...

scripts.speaker: White Knight
scripts.text: Please do not make a mess here.

scripts.speaker: Khalitzburg Knightage
scripts.text: Orders please.

scripts.speaker: White Knight
scripts.text: How do you know Varmundt? I heard that he's not really a friendly man...

scripts.speaker: Khalitzburg Knightage
scripts.text: Doesn't this castle seem weird all of a sudden? Something's not quite right.

scripts.speaker: White Knight
scripts.text: I do not like to chat during work.

scripts.speaker: White Knight
scripts.text: What can I do for you?

scripts.speaker: Khalitzburg Knightage
scripts.text: Is there something you need?

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: Where is your leader? I must talk to him.
Heinrich, you are in the castle now...

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text:
Ohh {0}
I guess I can trust you. Let's leave right away.
Sir Heinrich. Varmundt...
Sir Heinrich. Do you know what is happening in the castle now?

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: Aren't you the adventurer that came along with Varmundt?

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: What is it? Something wrong with the castle?
Himelmez's invasion...
Dead man's Valkyrie, Himelmez is coming to take the Ymir's Heart piece hidden inside this castle!

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: Haha. Funny. Do you really think that is possible?

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: I'm not kidding, Sir Heinrich. If I'm correct, then she will be here very soon.

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: We must hide the heart piece in a safe place before Himelmez's attack starts!
Even if you don't believe me...
I can't make you believe me, but there's no time to argue!

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: Thank you for the help. But we don't even have our king with us right now.

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: We cannot risk moving the heart just because some stranger says so.

scripts.speaker: Altar boy Domun
scripts.text: Save me, save me, please...

scripts.speaker: Altar boy Domun
scripts.text: Save me! Save me!!!
Hold on! Are you the only survivor?
Hold on! Are you the only survivor?

scripts.speaker: Altar boy Domun
scripts.text: Chamberlains... monks... They all turned into monsters. I couldn't do anything.

scripts.speaker: Altar boy Domun
scripts.text: All I could do was... Just hide in here... Nothing, nothing I could do...
Pull it together!
Wake up kid! Go east and find the middle passage to the outside! It is safe there!

scripts.speaker: Altar boy Domun
scripts.text: To the east passage? Alone? How?
I will give you a weapon.
Here's a weapon. Just close your eye and swing for those monsters.

scripts.speaker: Altar boy Domun
scripts.text: Ok, I... I'll try.

scripts.speaker: Holgren the Destroyer
scripts.text: You human?

scripts.speaker: Holgren the Destroyer
scripts.text: Die!! You shall die!!!
Relax! I'm not a monster!
Relax! I am Human. Are you alone? Is anyone else here?

scripts.speaker: Holgren the Destroyer
scripts.text: It's only me.
It's dangerous here...
It's dangerous here. You know the way to the middle passage? Can you move?

scripts.speaker: Holgren the Destroyer
scripts.text: Yes, I can move. I need to get out of here.
Be safe...
Sorry, I can't go with you.

scripts.speaker: Holgren the Destroyer
scripts.text: It's ok. You've already done enough. I can help myself. Good luck to you too.

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: Himelmez... I will never forget what you've done to my men.
^ff0000It seems like you have too many types or weights of items. Please organize your inventory.^000000

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text:
I guess this is it. Is it impossible to stop the time traveler's will?!
A portal seems to have appeared to the north.

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: This item has an extraordinary aura with it. Can be very useful for someone special.

scripts.speaker: Himelmez
scripts.text: Don't look at me nervous like that. It will be over soon...
^0000ffIt seems that you did not receive a reward for clearing the first floor. Talk to Varmundt and receive your reward.^000000

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: Himelmez's closed space covers everywhere...

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: How many times have I done this job? In my dream, I did it over and over again...

scripts.speaker: Heinrich
scripts.text: What are you putting on Himelmez!

scripts.speaker: Varmundt
scripts.text: Can't take off this bridle...

scripts.speaker: Gerhalt
scripts.text: Uuuuu... Khhhah! Just run away with the commander.

scripts.speaker: Himelmez
scripts.text: That is amazing ~ you made it all the way here. May I say thank you?

scripts.speaker: Himelmez
scripts.text: That is amazing ~ you made it all the way here. May I say thank you?
^ff0000It seems like you have too many types or weights of items. Please organize your inventory.^000000

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Hm, you are very well. First of all, let me give you some loot from Amdarais.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text:
Varmundt's time is stopped by me.
And your time will be distorted soon.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Maybe this poor time traveler will try to stop Glast Heim's tragedy from happening.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: However, we will never overlook his behavior now and forever...

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Now let me remove your memory. If you see me again it will be someone new.

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Oops. I almost distorted the time gap. Come over here. We need to go out!
You were just with me...

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text:
What did you say just before?
Anyway, that is not important. The gap of time will be closed so we need to get out of here.
Let me look around more
Please let me out

scripts.speaker: Hugin
scripts.text: Really? This place will be break down soon. Please look around quickly.
The crack looks suspicious but nothing more to check.
The crack looks suspicious but nothing more to check.
